svg.title: Current ASTIS Harness: theorem-sized Frontier Cells from source graph to Samplinglib
svg.desc: The current ASTIS Harness selects theorem-sized advances from the source and verified Lean graph, assigns each Frontier Cell to a Universal Worker, records discoveries and blockers, independently reviews theorem fidelity and hidden assumptions, and serializes verified changes through a single stabilization lane into Samplinglib.
svg.text: ASTIS Harness — current theorem-driven workflow
one theorem-sized advance per Frontier Cell · parallel mathematical work · independent statement review · serialized publication
INPUT / SHARED MATHEMATICAL STATE
Source mathematics + verified Samplinglib graph
Chewi textbook · papers · SampleWiki · existing Lean declarations · open theorem dependencies
THIN MASTER
Choose the next theorem-sized frontier
fix the target statement · record parents and truth boundary · assign one owner · avoid duplicate active work
The Master coordinates joins, conflicts, priority and publication order; it does not prescribe the proof route.
Parallel Frontier Cells
Independent theorem advances may run concurrently. Each cell has one Universal Worker responsible for the whole mathematical delta.
FRONTIER CELL A · UNIVERSAL WORKER
Recover → search → prove → test
1. Recover the exact statement and assumptions
2. Read parent declarations and nearby interfaces
3. Search Mathlib + Samplinglib before inventing APIs
4. Make a substantive local proof advance
5. Add a focused test for the theorem edge
claimed
proved_local
verified
FRONTIER CELL B · UNIVERSAL WORKER
Same worker contract, different theorem
A worker may do proof search, source reading,
API repair, refactoring, counterexample checks,
or theorem decomposition as the cell requires.
The unit of parallelism is mathematical progress,
not a fixed Upper / Middle / Lower role hand-off.
one owner end-to-end
independent theorem delta
BLOCKED CELL → STRICTLY SMALLER CHILD
Turn a real blocker into a theorem edge
If the parent cannot move, isolate the missing lemma,
interface, analytic condition, or Mathlib bridge.
The child must have a smaller proof boundary.
After independent verification, it returns to the
original worker and unlocks the parent cell.
DISCOVERY BUS / DURABLE GRAPH MEMORY
Share reusable discoveries without sharing ownership
theorem fingerprints · useful lemmas · failed routes · blocker boundaries · dependency edges · superseded interfaces · no-progress checkpoints
INDEPENDENT THEOREM REVIEW
Fidelity + denoising
Does the Lean statement still say the theorem we intended?
Are assumptions, domains, quantifiers and conclusions aligned?
Did the proof route introduce avoidable hypotheses or proof clutter?
Problems become explicit follow-up nodes; verified history is not silently rewritten.
SINGLE STABILIZATION LANE
Publish only the verified graph delta
exact reviewed head · focused theorem test · public import surface
root Lean build · fake-closure checks · graph/index regeneration
shared-file joins and merge order are serialized here
Only the stabilization owner can mark a cell merged.
PUBLISHED RESULT
Samplinglib + reader-facing Underlying Lean Graph
verified theorem nodes · explicit dependencies · reusable interfaces · open blockers · inspectable topology of mathematical contributions
published graph becomes the next run's starting state
